newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Davids says Don Bourke appointed CEO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Davids says Don Bourke appointed CEO.

text.p: Grocery wholesaler and retailer Davids Ltd said on Wednesday that John David had resigned as executive chairman and chief executive officer, effective immediately.
The company said Don Bourke had been appointed chief executive officer with Jeff David remaining in the positions of managing director and deputy chief executive officer.
John David will become non-executive chairman, the company said in a statement outlining a major rationalisation programme.
The company said on June 16 that joint managing director John Patten had resigned due to ill health and that Bourke had joined the company to assist in the rationalisation.
It also said he would act as chief financial officer while the company searched for an experience finance executive.
The appointment of Shane Allan as chief financial officer was announced on July 22.
